purpose: Feasibility assessment only for a separately fitted demographics-only exploratory transport study; not an admission of full Lumen55 or vessel models. No training/evaluation protocol has been activated.

angiocad_reduced_feasibility.reason: Header names do not verify clinical units, coding or measurement timing. No comments/codebook/customXML parts exist in the released workbook; accessible primary paper and dataset descriptions do not provide a codebook. No source field is approved. Dataset segment categories/boundaries and patient completeness need source clarification.
angiocad_reduced_feasibility.full_paper_access: Public browser paper page displayed CAPTCHA; not solved. Automated article API returned HTTP 429. No paywall bypass, private credential or request to authors used.

historical_uci45_demographics_option.license: CC BY 4.0 per current official dataset page
historical_uci45_demographics_option.source_provenance: Official names file dated July 1988: Hungarian Institute of Cardiology, University Hospitals Zurich/Basel, VA Long Beach. 1989 primary paper separately reports those hospital angiography groups. They are not UCI411/UCI412 Z-Alizadeh mirrors. Cleveland 303 is excluded from this option to avoid ambiguity with the original scope.

field_mapping.development_evidence: Original authors paper PMC4253773 Table 1 explicitly Age,year
field_mapping.external_evidence: Official names file attribute 3 age:age in years

field_mapping.mapping: Male->1; Fmale->0; any missing/other value unavailable rather than guessed
field_mapping.development_evidence: Original authors paper PMC4253773 Table 1 Male/Female; frozenLumen encoding Male/Fmale

endpoint_mapping.development: Recorded Cath CAD/Normal, original source defines >=50% diameter narrowing in at least one LAD/LCX/RCA.
endpoint_mapping.external: Recorded num:0 absent,1/2/3/4 present. Official angiographic disease description specifies <50% versus >50% in any major vessel.
endpoint_mapping.critical_difference: The strict >50% external rule and >=50% development rule have a 50% boundary mismatch; left-main/branch inclusion also differs or lacks a matching source rule. Retain original labels and disclose endpoint shift; do not call exactly harmonized same-target validation.
endpoint_mapping.excluded_features: Do not use ca, vessel labels, Cath, num, imaging, exercise test summaries, or any other predictors in a two-input model.

historical_uci45_demographics_option.model_scope: Parent would need to freeze a new development-242-only CAD demographic model and complete endpoint-shift protocol before acquiring/reading external patient rows. Frozen full55/all-four models stay unchanged.
historical_uci45_demographics_option.row_policy_required: Choose sites/files/inclusion and missingness rules before rows, one release file per hospital; do not count identical Age/Sex pairs as duplicate patients. Source-count differences from primary publication must be documented.
historical_uci45_demographics_option.modern_relevance: Historical transport stress test only. Does not establish contemporary prospective or clinical performance.
